Create a private GitHub repo for each enrolled student

Source: R/github.R
create_repos.Rd

Creates one private repo inside org for every roster row with enrolled == 1, named by that row's repo_col value (e.g. eda-jph). Repos that already exist are skipped, so the function is safe to re-run.

create_repos(roster, org, repo_col = "gh", add_readme = TRUE, dry_run = FALSE)

Arguments

roster

Course roster data frame. Must have netID, enrolled, and repo_col columns; name, if present, is used for the repo description.

org

GitHub organization to create the repos in (e.g. "eda-f26").

repo_col

Roster column holding each repo's exact name (e.g. "eda-jph"). Defaults to "gh".

add_readme

Initialize each repo with a README? Defaults to TRUE.

dry_run

If TRUE, print what would be created without calling gh. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per enrolled student and a status column (created, skipped, failed, or would_create).

Details

Requires the gh CLI to be installed and authenticated (gh auth login).
